notes: Override of ParticleEmitterFactory's single abstract method. Body: `return SoftCacheEntryReference(class348_sub42_sub8.method3193(i + 95), class348_sub42_sub8.anInt9545)` -- i.e. it reads the held value out of the incoming cache entry (via CacheEntryReference.method3193/'get', per refactor-notes/commonMain/CacheEntryReference.csv already documenting that method's Int param as an unused/decoy threshold check) and wraps it plus the entry's size (anInt9545) in a brand-new SoftCacheEntryReference. The one call site in the whole repo is LruByteCache.method578's LRU-eviction scan: for a CacheEntryReference that is NOT already soft (per CacheEntryReference.method3195/'isSoft') and whose access time has advanced past a threshold, it calls `aParticleEmitterFactory_5675!!.method1888(3, class348_sub42_sub8)` to obtain a soft-referenced replacement, stores it in the hashtable, and retires the original hard entry. This strongly suggests the real role of this ParticleEmitterFactory/ScaledParticleEmitter pairing is 'cache entry hard-to-soft demotion factory' rather than anything about particles -- flagging the class names as likely misleading (not renamed here per scope, method/param names only). The `i` param is passed as `i + 95` into method3193's own decoy threshold check (`if (i<=75) return null` in SoftCacheEntryReference); since the only observed call passes the literal 3 (giving 98, always > 75), it has no real effect on behavior at the one traced call site and is treated as unused.
